name: smith incline shoulder raises
description: A straight-arm shoulder-blade raise on an incline bench under a Smith bar, targeting the serratus anterior.
instructions: Set an incline bench under the Smith bar and lie back with your feet planted.
Take a comfortable overhand grip and hold the bar above your upper chest with straight arms.
Keeping your elbows straight, reach the bar upward a short distance by protracting your shoulder blades.
Lower your shoulders back toward the bench under control; keep the motion small rather than pressing the bar with bent elbows.
